company.name: Libra Robotics
company.shortDescription: Libra Robotics develops autonomous robots for large-scale solar panel installation and construction workflows.
company.description: Libra Robotics develops autonomous robots for solar panel installation on large-scale projects. The company designs tracked and wheeled robotic platforms that handle module transportation, alignment, placement, fastening, and quality checks as a full-cycle workflow. Its systems are compatible with mainstream fixed-tilt and single-axis-tracker racking and support applications such as utility-scale, commercial and industrial, community solar, and agrivoltaic installations. Libra Robotics provides integrated end-effectors, perception, and fastening tools along with user interfaces for supervised and remote operation. The robots are intended for use by EPCs, installation contractors, and racking and tracker manufacturers seeking to automate repetitive field tasks. Safety features such as multi-layer emergency stops, obstacle-aware autonomy, and managed network security are built into the deployment model.
